record.t: Signed, as Wyoming Secretary of State, a Memorandum of Agreement with the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services to use the Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements (SAVE) System to verify voter registration information.
record.q: the Secretary of State has signed a Memorandum of Agreement with the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services to utilize the Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements (SAVE) System. In accordance with SAVE, voter registration information provided by new registrants and registered voters may be verified against federal immigration records.

record.t: Was elected Wyoming's 24th Secretary of State.
record.q: Chuck Gray was elected Wyoming's 24th Secretary of State in 2022.

record.t: Was lead sponsor of Wyoming's voter ID law, which was signed into law in 2021.
record.q: He was also the lead sponsor of Wyoming's voter ID law, which was signed into law in 2021.

record.t: Served three terms in the Wyoming House of Representatives, representing House District 57 in Natrona County.
record.q: Prior to his tenure as Secretary of State, Secretary Gray served in the Wyoming House of Representatives for three terms, representing House District 57 in Natrona County.

record.t: Was lead sponsor of the ultrasound bill in his first legislative session.

record.t: Served on several legislative committees, including Judiciary, Revenue and Management Audit.

record.t: Serves on the State Loan and Investment Board, the Board of Land Commissioners, and the State Building Commission.

record.t: Filed an amicus curiae brief with the Colorado Supreme Court, joined by the Missouri and Ohio Secretaries of State.

record.t: Won the Republican nomination for Wyoming's at-large U.S. House seat.
